newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GENCOR PLANS TO GROW COLOMBIA NICKEL STAKE.
newsitem.headline: GENCOR PLANS TO GROW COLOMBIA NICKEL STAKE.

text.p: South African mining house Gencor Ltd said on Monday it planned to increase its stake in Colombian nickel producer Cerro Matoso S.A.

"There are discussions entered into and I would not be surprised if during the course of the next general annual meeting we increased our stake in that operation. I'm not forecasting. It will happen," Gencor chairman Brian Gilbertson said at a presentation of the group's year results.
Gencor owns 53 percent of the mine through its Dutch subsidiary Billiton. The Colombian government holds 47 percent but plans to privatise.
"It's early days yet but the government wishes to privatise and they have wished to privatise for a few years. We have got the pre-emption in that process," Gilbertson said.

"We don't necessarily want to excercise that (pre-emptive right to the shares) in total, but if in the process we are able to achieve some of our overall objectives for nickel that would suit us very well," he added.
Cerro Matoso's current nickel production was around 65 million pounds a year from 53 million pounds two years ago.
